name: bubble-reactions
title: Bubble: Reactions
description: Use `BubbleReactions` for bubble reactions. You can use it to display reactions or quick action buttons. Use `side` and `align` to position the row — `side="top"` anchors it to the upper edge. Reactions overlap the bubble edge, so leave vertical space between rows — the examples below use a larger `gap` for this reason.
